head_commit.message:
feat(core): add elapsed-ms to notify payload

Adds an `elapsed-ms` field to the `agent-turn-complete` notification
payload, allowing users to conditionally trigger desktop notifications
based on task duration (e.g., only notify when a task takes longer than
a threshold).

Fixes #9657

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
